title: Path Sum
tip: Root-to-leaf, not any path. Path variants show up constantly.
statement:
Return true if the tree has a **root-to-leaf** path such that the sum of node values equals `targetSum`.

Trees are given as level-order arrays (`null` for missing children).
constraints: The number of nodes is in [0, 10^4].
editorial: DFS remaining sum. Leaf check: no children and remaining == node.val.
